why: two cross-sectional families never tested here (COVERAGE_MAP / grep of all protocols): industry (sector) momentum, which in equities is stronger and more robust than stock momentum (Moskowitz-Grinblatt 1999), and network momentum, where an asset follows the momentum of the assets it is linked to (Pu, Roberts, Dong, Zohren 2023). Plain crypto XS momentum was rejected earlier; these use different information (group / neighbour returns, not the coin's own)
universe: 60 perps: 20 pack coins + 40 extra-pack coins, hourly closes and Binance funding; a coin enters once it has 120 days of history

trials.A sector momentum: every Monday 00:00 UTC: sector return = equal-weight mean of its eligible coins' 30-day returns (sectors with >= 2 eligible coins); long the top 2 sectors, short the bottom 2, equal weight per sector, split equally over its coins; dollar neutral; hold one week
trials.B network momentum: every Monday 00:00 UTC: own signal m_j = 30-day return / 90-day daily vol; neighbours = the 5 coins with the highest 90-day daily-return correlation; s_i = mean of the neighbours' m_j; long the top fifth, short the bottom fifth by s_i, equal weight; dollar neutral; hold one week
trials.C network minus own (residual): as B but s_i minus m_i (neighbour momentum the coin has NOT yet followed: the catch-up effect in the paper)

costs: 8 bp per side on traded notional at the rebalance + Binance funding paid / received hourly
judge: as a 10th v9.8 sleeve: book >= 3.211 + 0.05 and no period (2022 / 2023-24 / 2025-26) lower
